copper.$description: The interface accent: the owl's copper, measured from the logo pixels (L 0.703, C 0.092, H 52). One hue in both themes (owner, 2026-11-27). 400 is the hover, 600 the pressed step, 300 the dark link hover. Cocoa (brand.950) stays only in the product marks and the wordmark.

600.$description: Info text and solid fill. Raw ramp stop: components read status.info.*.

on-dark.$description: Info text on the dark inverse ground.

contrast.$description: Text on a solid info fill.

bg.$description: Tint behind a success message, badge or row.

text.$description: Success text and icons: 4.5:1 on the tint, the card and the page.

solid.$description: Solid success fill (a filled badge, a dot, a bar).

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the solid success fill.

bg.$description: Tint behind a warning message, badge or row.

text.$description: Warning text and icons: 4.5:1 on the tint, the card and the page.

solid.$description: Solid warning fill (a filled badge, a dot, a bar).

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the solid warning fill.

bg.$description: Tint behind a danger message, badge or row.

text.$description: Danger text and icons: 4.5:1 on the tint, the card and the page.

solid.$description: Solid danger fill (a filled badge, a dot, a bar).

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the solid danger fill.

bg.$description: Tint behind a info message, badge or row.

text.$description: Info text and icons: 4.5:1 on the tint, the card and the page.

solid.$description: Solid info fill (a filled badge, a dot, a bar).

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the solid info fill.

elevated.$description: A raised card, tile, notice or sticker. In dark a lighter step than surface.card, so it lifts off the page (a black shadow cannot show on a near-black page); in light it is the card white. Pair it with shadow.elevated. Cards in lists keep surface.card.

track.$description: The empty track of a progress bar, a step line, a disabled fill.

brand-hover.$description: Hover fill of a brand-coloured button.

field.$description: The quiet warm field behind the page that glass blurs. Its glows show at field.strength.

strength.$description: Opacity of the field glows: the glass strength.

disabled.$description: Text of a disabled control. Exempt from contrast (WCAG 1.4.3).

hover.$description: Border of a card, tile, tag or input on hover; a quiet separator mark.

_.$description: The accent fill, one hue in both themes. As a shape or icon on a light surface it reads 2.12 to 2.72:1, so the shape needs accent.edge; as text use text.link.

contrast.$description: The label on the accent fill: ink in both themes, 6.37:1 on copper.

edge.$description: The 1px edge of a copper fill, and the colour of a copper icon, line or thin fill (check mark, switch, tab underline, progress fill) on a light surface: 3.58 to 4.58:1. In dark it is the fill itself, so the edge is invisible and no layout moves. With Increase contrast the border ground is the control edge (#948A74, #7C725E), so the edge turns sand.800 in light (3.14 to 10.72:1) and brand.200 in dark (3.21 to 11.92:1).

warm.$description: A warm mark: a prompt, a busy dot, a hand-drawn underline. Not text.

soft.$description: A soft brand fill: a chip, a decoration. Not text.

elevated.$description: The shadow of a raised surface, used with surface.elevated. Light: a soft shadow. Dark: a 1px ring in border.strong, a faint top highlight and a deep shadow, because depth in dark comes from a lighter surface and a visible edge. Increase contrast: the ring is border.control.

exit.$description: Leaving: the same ease-out curve as ease.enter, because an exit uses ease-out too (the standard: ease-out for enters, exits and state changes).

emphasised.$description: One clear moment: a toast landing, a counter finishing. Overshoots slightly, so reduced motion swaps it for ease.standard.

fast.$description: A symbol swap, a copied check, a hover or focus colour. Also the reduced-motion fade.

base.$description: Something arriving or leaving in place: a notice, a menu, a card state.

slow.$description: A panel or drawer. Nothing in product UI is longer.

progress.$description: A bar moving to a new value. Always with the linear keyword, which has no numbers to share.

modal.$description: A modal, a drawer or a panel arriving. Its exit is dur.slow.

loop.$description: One turn of a looping pulse: a skeleton, a pending row, a loader. A loop stops under reduced motion, it is not shortened.

loop-slow.$description: One turn of a slower loop: a shimmer sweep, a status ring. Use with linear for a shimmer.

md.$description: How far an arriving thing travels.

lg.$description: A drawer or card entering; a reveal-on-scroll lift.

xl.$description: A long travel: a page or section transition, a sheet or side panel entering.

spinner-delay.$description: Wait this long before showing a spinner or skeleton.

spinner-min.$description: Once shown, keep a spinner or skeleton at least this long.

confirm.$description: How long a confirmation, such as a copied check, stays.

notice.$description: How long a notice stays before it dismisses itself.

click.$description: Ignore a second click this soon after the first.

glass.$description: One number sets how much glass the system shows. Owner, 2026-11-22: "halus" = 0.33 (round 2 of the study = 1, "sedang" = 0.5). Every material value is derived from it.

material.$description: Glass surfaces. Opacities of material.tint; every one becomes 1 (solid) under prefers-reduced-transparency, prefers-contrast: more and without backdrop-filter. Blur only what content scrolls under, at most four blurred surfaces, never nested. Sheets and popovers never animate opacity. No coloured glow: glass and filled controls carry neutral contact shadows only (owner, 2026-11-22).

tint.$description: The glass colour: paper white, card brown in dark.

clear.$description: Controls on a panel: theme switch, segmented control, search field.

regular.$description: Cards and panels on the static field. No backdrop blur.

chrome.$description: Bars that content scrolls under: the floating bar, toolbars, the tab bar.

thick.$description: Sheets and popovers. The floor keeps text behind them unreadable (ghost text at most 1.25:1 before blur).

blur-thick.$description: Backdrop blur of sheets and popovers: fixed, for the legibility rule.

spec.$description: Opacity of the white inner top highlight.

spec-low.$description: Opacity of the white inner bottom highlight.

sm.$description: The scale a tooltip or a dropdown enters from. Reduced motion: no scale.

lg.$description: The scale a modal or a panel enters from: a larger surface scales less. Reduced motion: no scale.
